newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Morococha jumps ten pct on bolsa.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Morococha jumps ten pct on bolsa.

text.p: Morococha's share price jumped ten percent by late trade Monday on the Lima Stock Exchange due to speculative buying from small investors taking advantage of the miner's recent popularity, brokers said.

"Even if it is true that zinc prices are high, the share price has gone beyond its ceiling," said Manuel Torres of local brokerage Finvest, adding the stock would likely fall back by the end of the day's session and see further corrections Tuesday.
The polymetallic miner's 10.0 percent jump took Morococha to 5.61 soles by 12.30 p.m. local time (1730 GMT), an hour before the four-hour session's close.
This month, Morococha -- along with another polymetallic miner Atacocha -- has led the sector's record bull run that has seen miners' liquid labor shares gain 114 percent since the start of the year.
The rises -- evident mainly in zinc producers -- were due to elevated international zinc prices and solid company performances that were likley to yield healthy second quarter profits, brokers said.
Morococha has been particularly attractive due to news earlier this month that Phelps Dodge Corp bought a 27 percent stake in the firm, they added.
But a rumor on the bolsa that Morococha has recently discovered new mineral resources also pushed the company's share price up, according to Miguel Bondy of local brokerage Andina de Capitales.
